name: Session Replay, Digital Experience & Product Analytics
description: Empirical benchmarks comparing open-source session recording, user journey telemetry, and product observability platforms against commercial SaaS toll providers (FullStory, LogRocket, Hotjar).

repositories.name: PostHog
repositories.highlight: Complete Product OS unifying session replay, heatmaps, web analytics, feature flags, and LLM telemetry on ClickHouse.

repositories.name: OpenReplay
repositories.highlight: Self-hosted developer-friendly session replay with network payload capture, Redux/Vuex state inspect, and canvas recording.

repositories.name: Highlight.io
repositories.highlight: Full-stack observability platform correlating frontend session recording with backend OpenTelemetry traces and errors.

commercial_alternatives_replaced.name: FullStory Enterprise
commercial_alternatives_replaced.pain_point: Aggressive per-session capture limits, data retention paywalls, and external cloud PII leakage risks.

commercial_alternatives_replaced.name: LogRocket Enterprise
commercial_alternatives_replaced.typical_pricing: $990 - $2,500+/mo based on seat count and monthly active sessions
commercial_alternatives_replaced.pain_point: Strict seat-tier gating, retention paywalls, and session overage penalty taxes.
